'''''Ingo Squadron''''' was a [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] of [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] employed by the [[Dimok government]]. During the final stages of the [[Sepan Civil War]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces led by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]] were to receive [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] from the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|Escort carrier]] ''[[Tropsobor]]''. During that time, both [[Dimok (people)|Dimok]] and [[Ripoblus (people)|Ripoblus]] forces had joined forces to [[Raid on the Tropsobor|attack]] Harkov while he was receiving his new fighters. The attack was repelled, thanks to [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] and Ingo Squadron was likely destroyed in the conflict.
